services.name: Fishing Trips
services.desc: A trip for every angler - Strike Charters offers four charter options designed to fit your schedule and goals on the water. Whether you're looking for a quick morning bite or a full day exploring the Cape Fear coast. Every trip includes all rods, reels, bait, tackle, and fishing licenses. Just show up and fish. All skill levels welcome - From kids catching their first fish to experienced anglers chasing trophy Redfish and Speckled Trout, Captain Drew tailors each trip to your group. Up to 4 anglers per charter with flexible AM or PM departures. blurb: Guests fish in the Cape Fear region of southeastern North Carolina targeting species like redfish, speckled trout, flounder, black drum, and sheepshead. Trips range from 3 to 8 hours and include all fishing gear, bait, boat, fuel, and captain's expertise. Passengers fish under the vessel's North Carolina for-hire license, so no individual license is needed.
